question: List the first 10 customers ordered by last name and first name.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer ORDER BY last_name, first_name LIMIT 10;

question: List the first 10 inactive customers ordered by last name and first name.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE active = 0 ORDER BY last_name, first_name LIMIT 10;

question: How many films are in the database?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film;

question: How many customers are in the database?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer;

question: List the first 10 films rated PG by title.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG' ORDER BY title LIMIT 10;

question: List the first 10 films with a rental rate of 0.99 by title.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rental_rate = 0.99 ORDER BY title LIMIT 10;

question: List the first 10 actors whose last name is Smith.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM actor WHERE last_name = 'SMITH' ORDER BY first_name LIMIT 10;

question: How many actors are in the database?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM actor;

question: How many customers belong to each store?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id;

question: List the 10 largest payments greater than 10 dollars.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_id, amount FROM payment WHERE amount > 10 ORDER BY amount DESC, payment_id LIMIT 10;

question: How many rentals occurred during 2005?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= '2005-01-01' AND rental_date < '2006-01-01';

question: List the first 10 films longer than 120 minutes.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT title, length FROM film WHERE length > 120 ORDER BY title LIMIT 10;

question: List the staff members' first name, last name, and username.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, username FROM staff ORDER BY staff_id;

question: List all language names alphabetically.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name FROM language ORDER BY name;

question: How many customers have no email address?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_email FROM customer WHERE email IS NULL;

question: Show each customer and their total payments, including customers who have made no payments.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_payments FROM customer c LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: Show the five customers who have paid the most in total.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payments FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_payments DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 5;

question: Count how many films belong to each category, including categories with no films.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY c.name;

question: Show the ten most-rented films and their rental counts.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY rental_count DESC, f.film_id LIMIT 10;

question: Find the average film length for each rating.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS average_length FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating;

question: List customers who have made at least 30 rentals.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(r.rental_id) >= 30 ORDER BY rental_count DESC, c.customer_id;

question: Show monthly payment revenue during 2005.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_date, '%Y-%m') AS payment_month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2005-01-01' AND payment_date < '2006-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY payment_month;

question: List actors who appeared in at least 20 films.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name HAVING COUNT(fa.film_id) >= 20 ORDER BY film_count DESC, a.actor_id;

question: Show total payment amount handled by each staff member, including staff with no payments.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_payments FROM staff s LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY s.staff_id;

question: List films whose replacement cost is greater than the average replacement cost of all films.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT film_id, title, replacement_cost FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > (SELECT AVG(replacement_cost) FROM film) ORDER BY replacement_cost DESC, title;

question: Count the cities in each country.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(ci.city_id) AS city_count FROM country co LEFT JOIN city ci ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id, co.country ORDER BY co.country;

question: List films that have never been rented.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id) ORDER BY f.title;

question: Show the five categories with the highest total payment revenue.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.name LIMIT 5;

question: Show each customer’s average payment and number of payments.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, AVG(p.amount) AS average_payment, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS payment_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: List films featuring actor Penelope Guiness.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS' ORDER BY f.title;

question: Find customers whose total payments are greater than the average total payments per customer, counting customers with no payments as zero.
ground_truth_sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT customer_id, total_amount FROM customer_totals WHERE total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM customer_totals) ORDER BY total_amount DESC, customer_id;

question: List films that have been rented from every store.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.store_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store) ORDER BY f.title;

question: List customers who made payments on at least two distinct dates.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(payment_date)) AS payment_dates FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(payment_date)) >= 2 ORDER BY customer_id;

question: List all films tied for the maximum film length.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT title, length FROM film WHERE length = (SELECT MAX(length) FROM film) ORDER BY title;

question: List customers who have rented films but have never made a payment.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: List films whose rental count is greater than the average rental count among films that have been rented at least once.
ground_truth_sql: WITH film_rentals AS (SELECT i.film_id, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY i.film_id) SELECT f.film_id, f.title, fr.rental_count FROM film_rentals fr JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fr.film_id WHERE fr.rental_count > (SELECT AVG(rental_count) FROM film_rentals) ORDER BY fr.rental_count DESC, f.title;

question: For each customer who has rented at least once, show their most recent rental date.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, MAX(r.rental_date) AS most_recent_rental FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: List pairs of different customers who share the same last name.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c1.customer_id AS customer_id_1, c1.first_name AS first_name_1, c1.last_name, c2.customer_id AS customer_id_2, c2.first_name AS first_name_2 FROM customer c1 JOIN customer c2 ON c1.last_name = c2.last_name AND c1.customer_id < c2.customer_id ORDER BY c1.last_name, c1.customer_id, c2.customer_id;

question: Find the largest individual payment associated with each film category.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, MAX(p.amount) AS max_payment FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY c.name;

question: List customers whose first payment occurred during 2005.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.customer_id, MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_payment_date FROM payment p GROUP BY p.customer_id HAVING MIN(p.payment_date) >= '2005-01-01' AND MIN(p.payment_date) < '2006-01-01' ORDER BY p.customer_id;
